properties.name: HSWM Ragnarok and PIDNA research ontology
properties.description: Bounded KG projection of two initialized research projects, their historical and scientific sources, operational concepts, metrics, hypotheses, and falsification boundaries.
properties.claim_boundary: Publication provides typed discoverability only and cannot establish HSWM learning, PIDNA ascent, Ragnarok avoidance, efficacy, or scientific discovery.

properties.name: HSWM Ragnarok research project
properties.description: Measures whether outcome-bound HSWM learning displaces static semantic harness and protocol burden as capability and composition scale.
properties.claim_boundary: The project does not establish that Ragnarok currently holds, has been avoided, or can only be solved by an efficacious HSWM implementation.

properties.name: PIDNA — Pure Intelligence DNA research project
properties.description: Tests whether conjecture and independently grounded verification form an outcome-bound causal recurrence that changes HSWM behavior across scales.
properties.claim_boundary: The project does not establish PIDNA as biology, a validated intelligence theory, HSWM cognition, or empirical ascent.

properties.name: PIDNA — Pure Intelligence DNA
properties.description: Recovered user-defined concept: progress as an ascending recurrence formed by conjecture and independently grounded verification, reinterpreted for current HSWM as an n-ary outcome-bound causal loop.
properties.claim_boundary: The name and historical two-strand meaning are recovered; the HSWM mapping, n-ary rung, fractal recurrence, and efficacy remain unjudged.

properties.name: LakatoTree TOUCH THE SKY historical source
properties.description: User-owned retired source for the red verification strand, blue conjecture strand, mutual gaze, paired rung, and ascending-helix metaphor.
properties.claim_boundary: The digest records what was read; the retired source is not copied, restored, or made a runtime dependency.

properties.name: LakatoTree PIDNA historical concept source
properties.description: User-owned retired source explicitly defining PIDNA, its strands, rung, ascent, branch questions, false replication analogy, and historical HSWM target mapping.
properties.claim_boundary: The historical meta-helix rejection remains distinct from the newly proposed functional scale-recurrence hypothesis.

properties.name: LakatoTree Pidna Lean formal kernel historical source
properties.description: Hand-written Lean model proving properties of its encoded deterministic judge, receipt-bearing rung, and same-target confirmation fold.
properties.claim_boundary: The formal source proves theorems inside a hand-written model; it does not prove external novelty truth, Python correspondence, HSWM learning, or empirical superiority.

properties.name: Hidden Technical Debt in Machine Learning Systems
properties.description: Primary literature bridge for glue code, configuration burden, entanglement, feedback loops, boundary erosion, and system maintenance debt.
properties.claim_boundary: The paper does not study LX3 Ragnarok, LLM harness scaling, PIDNA, or HSWM efficacy.

properties.name: Falsification and the Methodology of Scientific Research Programmes
properties.description: Primary philosophical source for prospective novelty and progressive versus degenerating research programs.
properties.claim_boundary: Lakatos does not define the HSWM engineering metrics, causal learning loop, or PIDNA implementation.

properties.name: Proofs and Refutations
properties.description: Primary philosophical source for knowledge growth through conjecture, attempted proof, counterexample, and concept revision.
properties.claim_boundary: The mathematical dialogue does not establish a neural, biological, or HSWM PIDNA mechanism.

properties.name: On the Logic of Theory Change
properties.description: Primary formal source for explicit contraction and revision operators on logical belief sets.
properties.claim_boundary: AGM belief revision is not outcome-bound HSWM causal learning and does not by itself represent provenance, permissions, or multiscale credit.
properties.authors: Carlos E. Alchourron; Peter Gardenfors; David Makinson

properties.name: PROV-O: The PROV Ontology
properties.description: W3C Recommendation for interoperable provenance entities, activities, agents, and qualified relations.
properties.claim_boundary: Provenance representation does not establish causal credit, truth, permission, cognition, or PIDNA ascent.

properties.name: Computational irreducibility
properties.description: Motivational source for the possibility that some process outcomes cannot be obtained without carrying out comparable computation.
properties.claim_boundary: Computational irreducibility is not operationalized here as proof that every PIDNA or HSWM transition must be executed in full.

properties.name: PIDNA blue conjecture role
properties.description: Role of schema-admissible conjecture, abstraction, prediction, proposal, and the trajectory it initiates; not a permanent subsystem or owner.
properties.claim_boundary: Generating a proposal does not constitute truth, credit, learning, or ascent.

properties.name: PIDNA red verification role
properties.description: Role of independently derived observation, intervention, measurement, falsifier, and explicit instrument uncertainty; not an infallible judge or permanent subsystem.
properties.claim_boundary: Deterministic processing cannot establish the truth, ownership, or independence of an ungrounded input.

properties.name: PIDNA n-ary causal rung
properties.description: Typed outcome-binding incidence connecting proposal, trajectory, independently grounded outcome, multiscale causal credit, admitted canonical revision, and changed later behavior.
properties.claim_boundary: A log pair, verdict, receipt, test pass, or ontology edge alone is not a causal rung.

properties.name: PIDNA ascent
properties.description: Sequence of causally valid rungs that improves prospective problem-solving under fresh, retention, safety, remove/restore, and resource controls.
properties.claim_boundary: More documents, verdicts, KG nodes, tests, or rungs do not imply ascent without prospective causal gain.

properties.name: PIDNA functional scale recurrence
properties.description: Hypothesized preservation of the same conjecture-action-outcome-credit-revision-changed-behavior recurrence at component and bounded composite HSWM scales.
properties.claim_boundary: Functional recurrence does not claim that a tree or hypergraph is geometrically a helix, nor that aggregation is an HSWM-of-HSWMs.

properties.name: Ragnarok diagnostic vector
properties.description: Non-scalar measurement vector spanning static harness load, interpretation share, manual exceptions, causal learning yield, evidence latency, instrument failures, scale overhead, and invariant effectiveness.
properties.claim_boundary: No composite score is authorized; every numerator, denominator, attribution method, uncertainty, and resource budget must remain visible.

properties.name: Ragnarok harness interpretation burden
properties.description: Attributable tokens, wall time, and human work used to load, resolve, repair, and apply static ordinary-cognition instructions rather than perform the measured task.
properties.claim_boundary: Instruction length alone is insufficient and necessary constitutional or safety boundaries must be classified separately.

properties.name: HSWM causal learning yield
properties.description: Admitted outcome-bound revisions that pass fixed-context intervention and change held-out behavior per call, token, compute, wall-time, and human-minute budget.
properties.claim_boundary: Durable writes, stored outcomes, green tests, or self-reported changes without intervention are excluded from the numerator.

properties.name: HSWM evidence latency
properties.description: Measured work from prospective registration or direct experiment start to the first valid causal block rather than the first green instrument.
properties.claim_boundary: Protocol success, validator success, and instrument production do not stop the clock unless the planned causal evidence block becomes valid.

properties.name: RAG-H1 learned displacement
properties.description: After fixed adaptation, an HSWM learned arm is non-inferior on fresh quality and needs less marginal static coordination than a strong static-harness arm.
properties.claim_boundary: Matched calls, tokens, compute, time, human work, hidden prompts, and quality margins are required.

properties.name: RAG-H2 causal ownership
properties.description: Any reduction in static burden is caused by admitted outcome-bound HSWM revisions that change later behavior.
properties.claim_boundary: Remove, shuffle, restore, and fixed-context behavior interventions are required.

properties.name: RAG-H3 capability scaling
properties.description: Increasing model capability lowers or holds constant measurable harness burden per valid outcome when the HSWM loop learns.
properties.claim_boundary: The harness and accounting contract must not be silently rewritten between capability levels.

properties.name: RAG-H4 scale closure
properties.description: Bounded HSWM composition preserves burden-reducing learning without a central workflow growing in proportion to coalition variety.
properties.claim_boundary: Federation, dashboards, message buses, and central aggregation are negative controls rather than evidence of HSWM-of-HSWMs.

properties.name: PID-H1 paired-cycle advantage
properties.description: The paired PIDNA arm yields more fresh causally validated revisions per equal budget than blue-only, red-only, and unpaired-log arms.
properties.claim_boundary: Extra calls, compute, latency, human work, or looser quality gates invalidate the comparison.

properties.name: PID-H2 behavioral rung
properties.description: A valid PIDNA rung causes an admitted canonical revision and changed next HSWM transition behavior.
properties.claim_boundary: A stored outcome, verdict, or revision without changed later behavior fails the hypothesis.

properties.name: PID-H3 hypergraph credit
properties.description: Typed n-ary incidence preserves shared and delayed causal credit better than forced 1:1 pairs or flat logs under matched information and compute.
properties.claim_boundary: Representation richness alone is not a win; calibration, counterfactual attribution, and replay must improve.

properties.name: PID-H4 functional scale recurrence
properties.description: The same causal recurrence closes at component and bounded composite HSWM scales under regrouping and model swap.
properties.claim_boundary: Central aggregation, lost member lineage, or failed intervention rejects the higher-scale claim.

properties.name: PID-H5 anti-Ragnarok verification
properties.description: Verification burden per causally validated revision remains bounded or decreases as valid PIDNA rungs accumulate without weakening invariant effectiveness.
properties.claim_boundary: Static gates, exceptions, or evidence latency growing faster than causal learning yield reject the hypothesis.
